Hmm ... obviously you can use several minions reacting to a bleed by
playing ecstasy (reducing the bleed by one each). Let's say you have two
minions reacting (each playing ecstasy) to a bleed of 2, which
eventually will resolve for 0. Will the acting minion take 1 damage due
to the last ecstasy or will it take 2 damage (1 for each ecstasy since
they both reacted to the same action and both made it resolve for 0
bleed)????

Thanks in advance
